# Testing at Key Widths

#### Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen

## Testing at Key Widths

Before you call a layout responsive, test it. Open DevTools, turn on responsive mode, and check these three widths.

320px — the narrowest phone still in use. A good worst-case test. Fix issues here first.

768px — tablet in portrait. The hero should switch to two columns, the hamburger should disappear, the nav should be a horizontal row.

1024px — small laptop. The full desktop layout should be visible and match what you built in the Figma course.

At each width look for four things. No content spilling past the right edge. No horizontal scrollbar. Text readable without zooming. Buttons large enough to tap, at least 44px tall.
